final: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.death_country, '') as death_country, AVG(pav.points_won) as avg_points_won FROM player_award_vote pav INNER JOIN player p ON pav.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.death_country, '')), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_points_won) as overall_avg FROM group_averages) SELECT ga.death_country, ga.avg_points_won, ga.avg_points_won - oa.overall_avg as difference_from_overall_avg FROM group_averages ga CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ORDER BY ga.death_country
